author: Jim Treacher
title: BREAKING: Presidential Aide Aids President
text:
Here’s a free podcast for all the freeloaders! Please pay me so I can keep doing this.
Transcript
It’s Wednesday, August 19, 2026. I’m allegedly Jim Treacher.
And until this week, I’m pretty sure I didn’t know who Natalie Harp is. I had heard of Susie Wiles. I’d heard of Hope Hicks. But I hadn’t heard of Natalie Harp.
She’s the current secretary to the president. Which we now call an “executive assistant,” because “secretary” is bad or something. It’s sexist.
You can go on Wikipedia and look at the list of all the personal secretaries to the president, going back to 1933. There have been other presidential secretaries since 1789. But this particular job title, the one Natalie Harp has now, that only goes back a century. She’s not the first one, is what I’m saying.
I went and looked through that list. I hadn’t heard of any of them in my lifetime. They were there, they did their job, apparently. But I didn’t know any of their names.
The only one I’ve even heard of is Evelyn Lincoln, who was JFK’s secretary. And that’s only because of the urban legend about the coincidences between JFK and Abraham Lincoln. You know: JFK had a secretary named Lincoln, and Lincoln supposedly had a secretary named Kennedy. That last part isn’t true, but that was the urban legend. That’s the only reason I’ve heard of Evelyn Lincoln.
Anyway, the point is: Who cares?
The president has a secretary. He has a staff, people who work for him. We all know this.
Then, the other day, Jon Ossoff insinuated that there’s something going on between Trump and Natalie Harp. So now, it’s off to the races.
Now, CNN airs crap like this. They dug up Natalie Harp’s brother, who’s apparently estranged from her, to badmouth her.
“Two sources, Preston, are telling CNN that your sister was involved. Okay. Back in October 2023, right? The context here is, Donald Trump’s motorcade was going to leave Trump Tower for a court appearance. Okay? And they were all getting into the motorcade. There was sort of a screaming match about who was getting in what car. And it turned out that there wasn’t room for Natalie, so she insisted… She said no, Trump had personally asked her to come to this court appearance, so she needed to be in the car. Now, according to these sources, the end result is that your sister jumped into the trunk of one of the motorcade vehicles to go to the court appearance in lower Manhattan.”
“That’s really funny. I didn’t even know about that.”
“I mean, what is your reaction to that? I mean, you’re laughing, but, I mean, is it funny or what? I mean, you know her, so that’s—”
“It’s actually kind of sad. That’s obsession. That’s like an unhealthy obsession with someone, if you’re going to jump into the trunk of their car. Like…”
“Totally, dude! Radical! Bogus!” Look out, Jeff Spicoli. Bill & Ted.
“Unhealthy obsession.” As opposed to healthy behavior, like going on TV to bash your own sister because you hate her boss. That’s healthy.
And why is Natalie Harp so loyal to Trump, anyway? The people need to know.
“How much do you think she truly believed that Trump saved her life?”
“Well, that’s an interesting question. But if she thinks about it, what he did was he made experimental drugs legal to try, and that insurance would pay for it. So it’s not like he, like, physically saved her life. You know, it’s kind of different. Like, it’s like, Donald Trump didn’t pay his own money to save my sister’s life. So it really just depends how you look at it. You know what I mean?”
So Trump didn’t really save her life, see. Republicans are responsible for killing people with their legislation, but never saving people. Only Democrats get credit for that.
Now, okay, caveat. I know Trump fans don’t like it when I say this, but I have to say it:
I don’t like Trump.
I’ve never voted for him. I have a lot of problems with him. If that makes you angry, so be it.
And, also, in addition to that: What the media is doing to this woman is wrong.
She works for the president. She’s loyal to him. I can respect that, no matter which president it is. Especially considering she isn’t one of the staffers whose job it is to lie to me.
Presidents have assistants. She’s hardly the first one. How is this news?
Her only crime is working for a president who defeated a Democrat. That’s it. That’s her sin.
Is there any proof she’s done anything illegal, or unethical, or anything? If so, let’s see it.
Instead, it’s “vibes.” Instead, they bring on her own brother to bash her.
Who, if you watch the video… You don’t even need to watch the video. Just look at the screencap. He looks like he sounds. He’s even wearing a hat that says “BUD of California.” Get it?
That’s CNN: “Hey, let’s put a wedge between this White House aide and her own family. That’s how we can get to the guy we don’t like. Because she was in a car with the president. She was on a plane with the president. Yeah, that’s her job, but so what? And if we can’t find out that she’s done anything wrong, we’ll just make something up.”
What have they got to lose? If it’s nothing, they’ll just move on, like they never did this. The drive-by media, as a wise man once called them.
By the way, does a Suburban even have a trunk? There’s like a storage area, but it’s not like curling up inside a car trunk. There’s plenty of room. I don’t know, whatever.
And again, this is all happening because the Secret Service protected the president from an assassination plot. These “journalists” are outraged that he wasn’t murdered. They can’t do anything about that, so the next best thing is just to try to turn it into some kind of negative.
Then again, I mean, who’s even watching CNN? They’re getting beat in the ratings by Andy Griffith, so…
I also watched a clip of Rosie O”Donnell on Jimmy Kimmel. She’s obsessed with Trump. She’s legitimately obsessed with Trump.
“This has been kind of a strange experience for me, because all of a sudden, I’m re-famous. I’m back in the spotlight. All thanks to President Oompa J. Loompa, who is watching us this evening from inside a catering cart. You know, I couldn’t have done it without you, sweetie. You brought me back, just like you did with fascism and the measles.”
I don’t know, I don’t have much to say about it beyond that. I’m just tired of the whole thing. It’s been 10 years of this. We get it. You hate him.
I just hope that one of these assassination plots doesn’t succeed. One, because it’s just bad on its own merits. But two, I don’t want to watch these people celebrate.
In entertainment news… Columbia House is dead.
“If you recognize the phrase ‘8 CDs for a penny,’ I have generational news for you tonight. After 71 years and a transition from vinyl to tapes to CD, Columbia House is no more. They once had 16 million members, but streaming killed the mail-order star. Last day for orders: September 15th.”
I never signed up for Columbia House, but I did make the mistake of joining BMG at some point in the ‘90s. Which was basically the same thing. I think it was a magazine ad: “Get 12 CDs for the price of one.” And then they’ll keep billing you for life, or until you cancel. So now, somewhere, I’ve got a box full of CDs I’ll never listen to, with the little BMG logo on them.
Now I’m like most people. I listen to Spotify all day. Which I think is bad for most music artists. Unless you’re Taylor Swift, or what’s her name… Ella Langley. One of those types. Unless you’re at the very, very top, you’re not making any money from Spotify.
But it’s a lot more convenient for me. That’s the important thing. And I don’t have even more boxes full of little plastic discs.
Which probably don’t even work anymore. I haven’t played a CD in years. But I know they break down over time, right? They’re probably just coasters now. Oh well.
Quick streaming pick: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie on Hulu.
I’m not even sure where to start with this one. It’s one of the strangest movies I’ve seen in a while. I’m not sure I understood a lot of it. And it’s a blast. It’s hilarious.
And no, it has nothing to do with the actual band Nirvana. It’s spelled differently, for one thing. That makes all the difference. And they’re not really even a band.
I’m not exactly sure what the joke is supposed to be there. Which is the point, I think. It’s like these two guys have turned their own little private jokes and obsessions into a comedy act. And it works. It worked for me, anyway.
Hulu also has Nirvanna the Band the Show, which was the precursor to this, like 10 years ago. I’ve only watched the first episode, but it was also laugh-out-loud funny, and I plan to watch the rest.
And 10 years before that, there was a web series, Nirvanna the Band the Show, which they just filmed themselves in their apartment. Each iteration of this, every decade, they get more and more money to pull these crazy stunts for the same incredibly low stakes.
Between Trailer Park Boys, Letterkenny and Shoresy, and this, it’s good to know there are still Canadians who are funny on purpose.
Oh, and the guy with the hat you saw there, he wrote and directed this Anthony Bourdain movie that’s coming out on Friday. He’s like a legit Hollywood director now.
So now, maybe we’ll get Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie Two. Or Again. Or Comes Back. Or Endgame.
Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie: Endgame. Yeah.
Alright, that’s it. See ya later, seppos.
